configuration.memory_measurement: tracemalloc peak during union construction; direct query uses existing Vertices roots

union_path.operation: union = a | b; hits = sum(vertex in union for vertex in range(n))

direct_path.operation: hits = sum(vertex in a or vertex in b for vertex in range(n))
direct_path.traced_peak_bytes: not separately captured; no retained/materialized union

full_refinement_comparison.measurement: tracemalloc peak/time around refine_hierarchy; base hierarchy built before tracing
full_refinement_comparison.attribution: combined ADR 0063/0064/0065 candidate changes; not isolated to union removal

limits: One host and three refinement samples; this is not million-vertex qualification.
The old_s union and membership checks are modeled by direct membership over disjoint source partitions; promotion updates and new A/B roots are not included.
This does not measure other hierarchy union construction or total process RSS.
